theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuit.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (bits : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuit bits =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore (List.length bits + 1) bits with     | some (c, []) => some c     | x => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString), MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore 0 x = none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: false :: false :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat rest with     | some (i, tail) => some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.input i, tail)     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: false :: true :: rest) =     some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const false, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: true :: false :: rest) =     some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const true, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: true :: true :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (c, tail) => some (c.not, tail)     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (true :: false :: false :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (a, rest') =>       match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest' with       | some (b, tail) => some (a.and b, tail)       | none => none     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (true :: false :: true :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (a, rest') =>       match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest' with       | some (b, tail) => some (a.or b, tail)       | none => none     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_8
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString) (fuel : Nat),   (∀ (rest : List Bool), x = false :: false :: false :: rest → False) →     (∀ (rest : List Bool), x = false :: false :: true :: rest → False) →       (∀ (rest : List Bool), x = false :: true :: false :: rest → False) →         (∀ (rest : List Bool), x = false :: true :: true :: rest → False) →           (∀ (rest : List Bool), x = true

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore_encode_append
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit) (tail : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString) (fuel : Nat),   MCore.CircuitK1.size c < fuel →     MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel (MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit c ++ tail) =       some (c, tail)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuit_encode
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuit (MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit c) = some c

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat.eq_1
theorems.statement: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat [] = none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (rest : List Bool), MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat (false :: rest) = some (0, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat (true :: rest) = do     let __discr ← MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat rest     match __discr with       | (n, tail) => some (n + 1, tail)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat_encodeNat_append
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (tail : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat (MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat n ++ tail) = some (n, tail)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (i : Nat),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.input i) =     [false, false, false] ++ MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat i

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit.eq_2
theorems.statement: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const false) = [false, false, true]

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit.eq_3
theorems.statement: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const true) = [false, true, false]

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit c.not =     [false, true, true] ++ MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit c

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit (a.and b) =     [true, false, false] ++ MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit a ++       MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit b

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit (a.or b) =     [true, false, true] ++ MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit a ++       MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeCircuit b

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat.eq_1
theorems.statement: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat 0 = [false]

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : Nat), MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat n.succ = true :: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.encodeNat n

theorems.statement: ∀ (x : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString), MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore 0 x = none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: false :: false :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat rest with     | some (i, tail) => some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.input i, tail)     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: false :: true :: rest) =     some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const false, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: true :: false :: rest) =     some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const true, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: true :: true :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (c, tail) => some (c.not, tail)     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (true :: false :: false :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (a, rest') =>       match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest' with       | some (b, tail) => some (a.and b, tail)       | none => none     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (true :: false :: true :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (a, rest') =>       match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest' with       | some (b, tail) => some (a.or b, tail)       | none => none     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuit.eq_1

theorems.statement: ∀ (x : MCore.Real.CanonicalFinalProof.BitString), MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore 0 x = none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: false :: false :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeNat rest with     | some (i, tail) => some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.input i, tail)     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: false :: true :: rest) =     some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const false, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: true :: false :: rest) =     some (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.const true, rest)

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (false :: true :: true :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (c, tail) => some (c.not, tail)     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (true :: false :: false :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (a, rest') =>       match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest' with       | some (b, tail) => some (a.and b, tail)       | none => none     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (fuel : Nat) (rest : List Bool),   MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel.succ (true :: false :: true :: rest) =     match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest with     | some (a, rest') =>       match MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore fuel rest' with       | some (b, tail) => some (a.or b, tail)       | none => none     | none => none

theorems.name: MCore.Real.CanonicalCircuitBits.decodeCircuitCore.eq_8

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.one_sub_mem_zerosUpTo

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.reflect_coe
theorems.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ) (ρ : ↥(LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosFinset T)), ↑(LiCriterion.Zeta.reflect T ρ) = 1 - ↑ρ

theorems.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ), Function.Involutive (LiCriterion.Zeta.reflect T)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.riemannHypothesis_iff_liTrunc
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n).re

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.riemannHypothesis_iff_stripRH
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ LiCriterion.Zeta.StripRH

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.stripRH_iff_liTrunc
theorems.statement: LiCriterion.Zeta.StripRH ↔ ∀ (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n).re

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.stripZero_of_hardyZ
theorems.statement: ∀ {t : ℝ}, hardyZ t = 0 → LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero (1 / 2 + ↑t * Complex.I) ∧ (1 / 2 + ↑t * Complex.I).re = 1 / 2

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.stripZero_one_sub
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero s → LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero (1 - s)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.trivial_of_re_nonpos
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, riemannZeta s = 0 → s.re ≤ 0 → ∃ n, s = -2 * (↑n + 1)

theorems.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ), (LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo T).Finite

theorems.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ), LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo T ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 (1 + |T|) ∩ riemannZetaZeros

theorems.name: LiCriterion.example_off_line
theorems.statement: ∃ n, (LiCriterion.liCoeff ![↑(3 / 5) + Complex.I, ↑(2 / 5) - Complex.I] n).re < 0

theorems.name: LiCriterion.example_on_line
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ![↑(1 / 2) + Complex.I, ↑(1 / 2) - Complex.I] n).re

theorems.name: LiCriterion.exists_liCoeff_re_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) → (∃ i, 1 / 2 < (ρ i).re) → ∃ n, (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re < 0

theorems.name: LiCriterion.liCoeff_eq_li_original
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) →     ∀ (σ : ι ≃ ι), (∀ (i : ι), ρ (σ i) = 1 - ρ i) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i, (1 - (1 - 1 / ρ i) ^ n) = LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n

theorems.name: LiCriterion.liCoeff_re
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (ρ : ι → ℂ) (n : ℕ),   (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re = ↑(Fintype.card ι) - ∑ i, (LiCriterion.liPoint (ρ i) ^ n).re

theorems.name: LiCriterion.liCoeff_re_nonneg
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) → (∀ (i : ι), (ρ i).re ≤ 1 / 2) → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re

theorems.name: LiCriterion.liPoint.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (ρ : ℂ), LiCriterion.liPoint ρ = ρ / (ρ - 1)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.li_criterion_finite
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) → ((∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), (ρ i).re ≤ 1 / 2)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.li_criterion_finite_symm
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) →     ∀ (σ : ι → ι),       (∀ (i : ι), ρ (σ i) = 1 - ρ i) → ((∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), (ρ i).re = 1 / 2)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.normSq_sub_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (ρ : ℂ), Complex.normSq (ρ - 1) = Complex.normSq ρ - 2 * ρ.re + 1

theorems.name: LiCriterion.norm_liPoint_eq_one_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ {ρ : ℂ}, ρ ≠ 1 → (‖LiCriterion.liPoint ρ‖ = 1 ↔ ρ.re = 1 / 2)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.norm_liPoint_le_one_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ {ρ : ℂ}, ρ ≠ 1 → (‖LiCriterion.liPoint ρ‖ ≤ 1 ↔ ρ.re ≤ 1 / 2)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.one_lt_norm_liPoint_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ {ρ : ℂ}, ρ ≠ 1 → (1 < ‖LiCriterion.liPoint ρ‖ ↔ 1 / 2 < ρ.re)

theorems.name: LiCriterion.one_sub_inv_one_sub
theorems.statement: ∀ {ρ : ℂ}, ρ ≠ 1 → 1 - 1 / (1 - ρ) = LiCriterion.liPoint ρ

theorems.statement: ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),   2 ∉ v.asIdeal →     (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation (ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Kv v)           (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal ↥(ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Rv v)))         (ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Wv v).Δ =       1

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Δ_E
theorems.statement: ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),   (ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Wv v).Δ =     (algebraMap (↥(ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Rv v)) (ClayBSDProof.LocalFactorsE32.Kv v)) 2 ^ 6

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : WeakFEPair ℂ), ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda P = (Set.Ioi 1).indicator fun x => P.f x - P.f₀

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.f_modif_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : WeakFEPair ℂ) {x : ℝ},   0 < x →     P.f_modif x = ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda P x + P.ε • ↑x ^ (-↑P.k) • ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda P.symm x⁻¹

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.mellinConvergent_cauda
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : WeakFEPair ℂ) (s : ℂ), MellinConvergent (ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda P) s

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.mellinConvergent_f_modif
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : WeakFEPair ℂ) (s : ℂ), MellinConvergent P.f_modif s

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.Λ₀_eq_caudas
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : WeakFEPair ℂ) (s : ℂ),   P.Λ₀ s = mellin (ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda P) s + P.ε * mellin (ClayBSDProof.MellinFold.cauda P.symm) (↑P.k - s)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ), ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x = 4 * HurwitzZeta.oddKernel (↑(1 / 4)) (2 * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K * x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.At.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ) (m : ℤ),   ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.At x m = (4 * ↑m + 1) * Real.exp (-(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c * (4 * ↑m + 1) ^ 2 * x))

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K.eq_1
theorems.statement: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K = 8 * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c / Real.pi

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K_pos
theorems.statement: 0 < ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K_sq
theorems.statement: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K ^ 2 = 8

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ), ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x = HurwitzZeta.cosKernel (↑(1 / 2)) (4 * x / ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Tt.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ) (j : ℤ),   ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Tt x j = Real.cos (Real.pi * ↑j) * Real.exp (-(4 * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c * ↑j ^ 2 * x))

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.U.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (y : ℝ), ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.U y = 4 * HurwitzZeta.oddKernel (↑(1 / 4)) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K * y)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Ut.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (y : ℝ) (m : ℤ),   ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Ut y m = (4 * ↑m + 1) * Real.exp (-(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c / 2 * (4 * ↑m + 1) ^ 2 * y))

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.V.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (y : ℝ), ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.V y = HurwitzZeta.evenKernel (↑(1 / 4)) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K * y)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Vt.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (y : ℝ) (m : ℤ), ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Vt y m = Real.exp (-(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c / 2 * (4 * ↑m + 1) ^ 2 * y))

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.abscissa_curva32
theorems.statement: LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv (ClayBSDProof.Continuation.coef ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E) ≤ ↑(3 / 2)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.bsd_posto_curva32_completo
theorems.statement: ∃ G,   ClayBSDProof.Continuation.Continuacao ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E G ∧     (∀ (G' : ℂ → ℂ), ClayBSDProof.Continuation.Continuacao ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E G' → G' = G) ∧       G 1 ≠ 0 ∧ analyticOrderAt G 1 = ClayBSDProof.Continuation.postoMW ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.bsd_posto_curva32_incondicional
theorems.statement: ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ},   ClayBSDProof.Continuation.Continuacao ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E G →     G 1 ≠ 0 ∧ analyticOrderAt G 1 = ClayBSDProof.Continuation.postoMW ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c_pos
theorems.statement: 0 < ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c_sq
theorems.statement: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c ^ 2 = Real.pi ^ 2 / 8

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.caixa.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.caixa n = {p ∈ Finset.Icc (-↑n) ↑n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-↑n) ↑n | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = ↑n}

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.coef_caixa
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ),   ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E.LFunction n =     ∑ p ∈ ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.caixa n with ClayBSDProof.GaussPrimary.Prim { re := p.1, im := p.2 }, p.1

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.cos_pi_int
theorems.statement: ∀ (j : ℤ), Real.cos (Real.pi * ↑j) = if j % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.cos_quarto
theorems.statement: ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → HurwitzZeta.cosKernel (↑(1 / 4)) t = HurwitzZeta.cosKernel (↑(1 / 2)) (4 * t)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.cota_caixa
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), |↑(ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E.LFunction n)| ≤ ∑ p ∈ ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.caixa n, √↑n

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.equacao_UV
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ},   0 < x →     ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.U (1 / x) * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.V (1 / x) =       x ^ 2 * (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.equacao_funcional
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ},   0 < x →     ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A (1 / x) * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T (1 / x) =       x ^ 2 * (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.existe_continuacao
theorems.statement: ClayBSDProof.Continuation.Continuacao ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Lcurva32

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.f.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ) (p : ℤ × ℤ),   ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.f x p =     if ClayBSDProof.GaussPrimary.Prim { re := p.1, im := p.2 } then       ↑p.1 * Real.exp (-(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c * (↑p.1 ^ 2 + ↑p.2 ^ 2) * x))     else 0

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.fat_ab
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → HasSum (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.f x) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.fat_uw
theorems.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → HasSum (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.f y) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.U y * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.V y)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.fibra
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), (fun p => (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2).toNat) ⁻¹' {n} = ↑(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.caixa n)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_A
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → HasSum (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.At x) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_T
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → HasSum (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Tt x) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_U
theorems.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → HasSum (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Ut y) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.U y)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_V
theorems.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → HasSum (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.Vt y) (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.V y)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_coef
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ},   0 < x →     HasSum (fun n => ↑(ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E.LFunction n) * Real.exp (-(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c * ↑n * x)))       (ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_cos
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ) {t : ℝ},   0 < t →     HasSum (fun n => Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * a * ↑n) * Real.exp (-Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * t)) (HurwitzZeta.cosKernel (↑a) t)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.hasSum_sin
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ) {t : ℝ},   0 < t →     HasSum (fun n => ↑n * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * a * ↑n) * Real.exp (-Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * t))       (HurwitzZeta.sinKernel (↑a) t)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.lseriesSummable_curva32
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, 3 / 2 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (ClayBSDProof.Continuation.coef ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E) s

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.pi_div_K
theorems.statement: Real.pi / ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.K = ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.ponteModular_curva32
theorems.statement: ClayBSDProof.AtaqueBSD.PonteModular ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E ClayBSDProof.AtaqueBSD.c32 1

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.prim_coord
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : ℤ), ClayBSDProof.GaussPrimary.Prim { re := a, im := b } ↔ b % 2 = 0 ∧ (a + b) % 4 = 1

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.re_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → GaussianInt), (∑ i ∈ s, g i).re = ∑ i ∈ s, (g i).re

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.sin_quarto
theorems.statement: ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → HurwitzZeta.sinKernel (↑(1 / 4)) t = 8 * HurwitzZeta.oddKernel (↑(1 / 4)) (16 * t)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.sumAbs
theorems.statement: ∀ {f : ℤ → ℝ} {a : ℝ}, HasSum f a → Summable fun n => ‖f n‖

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.summable_rede
theorems.statement: ∀ {t : ℝ}, 1 < t → Summable fun p => (↑p.1 ^ 2 + ↑p.2 ^ 2) ^ (-t)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.teta_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ},   0 < x →     ClayBSDProof.AtaqueBSD.teta ClayBSDProof.CongruentCurve.E ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.c x =       ↑(ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.A x * ClayBSDProof.ModularE32.T x)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.addX_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic] (x₁ x₂ ℓ : ℚ),   (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ (ℓ + W.a₁ / 2) = W.toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ℓ

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.addY_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic] (x₁ x₂ y₁ ℓ : ℚ),   (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).toAffine.addY x₁ x₂       (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x₁ y₁) (ℓ + W.a₁ / 2) =     ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W (W.toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ℓ) (W.toAffine.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ ℓ)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.delta_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ), (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).Δ = W.Δ

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.eliptica_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic], (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).IsElliptic

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.equation_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) (x y : ℚ),   (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).toAffine.Equation x       (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y) ↔     W.toAffine.Equation x y

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.fraco_de_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic],   (nsmulAddMonoidHom 2).range.FiniteIndex → (nsmulAddMonoidHom 2).range.FiniteIndex

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic],   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.zero =     WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.zero

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic] (x_1 y : ℚ) (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x_1 y),   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W (WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x_1 y h) =     WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x_1 (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x_1 y) ⋯

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudarEquiv.congr_simp
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic],   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudarEquiv W = ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudarEquiv W

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar_add
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic] (P Q : W.toAffine.Point),   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W (P + Q) =     ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W P + ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W Q

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar_injective
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic],   Function.Injective (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar_some
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic] {x y : ℚ} (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y),   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W (WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h) =     WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y) ⋯

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar_surjective
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic],   Function.Surjective (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [inst : W.IsElliptic], ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.mudar W 0 = 0

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.negY_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) (x y : ℚ), (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).toAffine.negY x y = -y

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.nonsingular_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic] {x y : ℚ},   W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y →     (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).toAffine.Nonsingular x       (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y)

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ),   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W =     { a₁ := 0, a₂ := W.a₂ + W.a₁ ^ 2 / 4, a₃ := 0, a₄ := W.a₄ + W.a₁ * W.a₃ / 2, a₆ := W.a₆ + W.a₃ ^ 2 / 4 }

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.slope_normal
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic] {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : ℚ},   W.toAffine.Equation x₁ y₁ →     W.toAffine.Equation x₂ y₂ →       ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = W.toAffine.negY x₂ y₂) →         (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.normal W).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂             (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x₁ y₁)             (ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x₂ y₂) =

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) (x y : ℚ), ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y = y + (W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) / 2

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN_inj
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) {x y y' : ℚ},   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y = ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y' → y = y'

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN_negY
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) (x y : ℚ),   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x (W.toAffine.negY x y) =     -ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.ChangeOfVariables.yN W x y

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz.fat
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {R : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F} {e e' e'' : F},   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz R e e' e'' →     ∀ (x : F), ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.f R x = (x - e) * (x - e') * (x - e'')

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz.ne₁
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {R : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F} {e e' e'' : F},   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz R e e' e'' → e ≠ e'

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz.ne₂
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {R : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F} {e e' e'' : F},   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz R e e' e'' → e ≠ e''

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz.soma
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {R : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F} {e e' e'' : F},   ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raiz R e e' e'' → e + e' + e'' = R.e₁ + R.e₂ + R.e₃

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes.h₁₂
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] (self : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F), self.e₁ ≠ self.e₂

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes.h₁₃
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] (self : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F), self.e₁ ≠ self.e₃

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes.h₂₃
theorems.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] (self : ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes F), self.e₂ ≠ self.e₃

theorems.name: ClayBSDProof.MordellWeil.Field.Raizes.mk.inj

theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) {σ : ℝ},   1 / 2 < σ →     ∀ {l : ℝ},       0 < l →         MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t => t ^ (σ - 1) * |ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t|)             (Set.Ioc 0 1) MeasureTheory.volume →           ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioc 0 1, t ^ (σ - 1) * |ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t| ≤             (l * ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.residualSq N c +

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.integral_tail_weighted
theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) {σ : ℝ},   σ < 1 →     ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 1, t ^ (σ - 1) * |ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t| =       |ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.tailS c| / (1 - σ)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.key_ineq
theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) {s : ℂ},   1 / 2 < s.re →     s.re < 1 →       riemannZeta s = 0 →         ∀ {l : ℝ},           0 < l →             1 / ‖s‖ ≤               (l * ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.residualSq N c + 1 / (l * (2 * s.re - 1))) / 2 +                 √(ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.residualSq N c) / (1 - s.re)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.mellin_res
theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) {s : ℂ},   0 < s.re →     s.re < 1 →       riemannZeta s = 0 →         MellinConvergent (fun t => ↑(ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t)) s ∧           mellin (fun t => ↑(ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t)) s = 1 / s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.norm_mellin_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℂ), ‖mellin (fun t => ↑(f t)) s‖ ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, t ^ (s.re - 1) * |f t|

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) (t : ℝ),   ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t =     ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.chi t - ∑ k, c k * ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.rho (↑k + 1) t

theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) {t : ℝ},   1 < t → ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t = -ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.tailS c / t

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.residualSq_eq_res
theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ),   ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.residualSq N c =     ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.res c t ^ 2

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.rho_of_gt_one
theorems.statement: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 1 ≤ k → ∀ {t : ℝ}, 1 < t → ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.rho k t = 1 / (↑k * t)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.Sufficiency.tailS_sq_le

theorems.statement: Filter.Tendsto ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.DN Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →   ∀ {s : ℂ}, 1 / 2 < s.re → s.re < 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.residualSq_extend

theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (c : Fin N → ℝ), 0 ≤ ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.residualSq N c

theorems.statement: Filter.Tendsto ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.DN Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ↔ ⨅ N, ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.DN N = 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.add_c2
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.BC), (a + b).c2 = a.c2 + b.c2

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.divisor_de_zero
theorems.statement: (1 + ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.k) * (1 - ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.k) = 0 ∧   1 + ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.k ≠ 0 ∧ 1 - ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.k ≠ 0

theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.BC),   w = 0 ↔ ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.plus w = 0 ∧ ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.minus w = 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.iBC.eq_1

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.i_sq
theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.iBC * ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.iBC = -1

theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.BC), ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.minus w = w.c1 + Complex.I * w.c2

theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : ClayRiemannProof.Bicomplex.BC), (a * b).c1 = a.c1 * b.c1 - a.c2 * b.c2

theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Target ↔ ∀ s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z, (ClayRiemannProof.Bridges.lam s).im = 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho_fixo_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho s = s ↔ s.im = 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho_mem_Z
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.fimLivre_mono
theorems.statement: ∀ {a a' : ℝ}, a ≤ a' → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.FimLivre a → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.FimLivre a'

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.fimLivre_um
theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.FimLivre 1

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.fim_iff_inicio
theorems.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.FimLivre a ↔ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.InicioLivre (1 - a))

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.im_ne_zero_of_mem_Z
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z → s.im ≠ 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.inicioLivre_mono
theorems.statement: ∀ {b b' : ℝ}, b' ≤ b → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.InicioLivre b → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.InicioLivre b'

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.inicioLivre_zero
theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.InicioLivre 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.mem_Z_iff_nao_trivial
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z ↔ riemannZeta s = 0 ∧ ¬ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Trivial s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.quarteto
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z →     ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho s ≠ s ∧       ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s ≠ s ∧         (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s = s ↔ s.re = 1 / 2) ∧           (s.re ≠ 1 / 2 →             ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s ≠ s ∧               ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho s ≠ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.te

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.re_compressao
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (s : ℂ), (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.compressao l s).re = 1 / 2 + l * (s.re - 1 / 2)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.re_tensao
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s).re = 1 - s.re

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.re_torcao
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s).re = 1 - s.re

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.re_trivial
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Trivial s → s.re < 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.riemann_iff_colares
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z, |s.re - 1 / 2| < ε

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.riemann_iff_compressao
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔   ∀ s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z, ∀ (l : ℝ), (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.compressao l s).re = s.re

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.riemann_iff_fim
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ (a : ℝ), 1 / 2 < a → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.FimLivre a

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.riemann_iff_inicio
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ b < 1 / 2, ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.InicioLivre b

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.riemann_iff_torcao
theorems.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z, ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s = s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.riemann_imp_re
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, RiemannHypothesis → s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z → s.re = 1 / 2

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.rigidez_neutro
theorems.statement: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),   (∀ (s : ℂ), f (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s) = ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao (f s)) →     f (1 / 2) = 1 / 2

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s = 1 - s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao_fixo_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s = s ↔ s = 1 / 2

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao_mem_Z
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao_tensao
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s) = s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ),   ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s =       ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho s) ∧     ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s =       ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.espelho (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.tensao s)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao_fixo_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s = s ↔ s.re = 1 / 2

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao_mem_Z
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s ∈ ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Z

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao_torcao
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao (ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.torcao s) = s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.uniao_fins
theorems.statement: ⋃ a ∈ Set.Ioi (1 / 2), Set.Ici a = Set.Ioi (1 / 2)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.uniao_inicios
theorems.statement: ⋃ b ∈ Set.Iio (1 / 2), Set.Iic b = Set.Iio (1 / 2)

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.zero_na_faixa
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, riemannZeta s = 0 → ¬ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Trivial s → 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.zero_trivial_de_re_nao_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, riemannZeta s = 0 → s.re ≤ 0 → ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.Trivial s

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.zeta_meio_neg
theorems.statement: ∃ x < 0, riemannZeta (1 / 2) = ↑x

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.zeta_ne_zero_real
theorems.statement: ∀ {σ : ℝ}, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → riemannZeta ↑σ ≠ 0

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.Zeta.Symmetry.zeta_real_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ {σ : ℝ}, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → ∃ x < 0, riemannZeta ↑σ = ↑x

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.gap_iff_tendsto
theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Gap ↔ Filter.Tendsto ClayRiemannProof.BaezDuarte.DN Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Target → ClayRiemannProof.Gap

theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Target → ClayRiemannProof.OpenAIQuasiRH78

theorems.name: ClayRiemannProof.riemannZeta_one_sub_eq_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, riemannZeta s = 0 → 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → riemannZeta (1 - s) = 0

theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Target ↔ ClayRiemannProof.Gap

theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.OpenAIQuasiRH78 → (ClayRiemannProof.Target ↔ ClayRiemannProof.NoZero_half_78)

theorems.statement: ClayRiemannProof.Gap → ClayRiemannProof.Target
